name: Yarasete! Teacher Come back Riko
original_name: やらせてっ！てぃーちゃーCome back理子
source:
The iconic original heroine Riko-sensei is making a comeback! 
Several years have passed since her union with Yuuta in the concluding part of the previous series. But what was supposed to be a sweet married life turns out to be quite unexpected, especially with Yuuta, the infamous pervert. This story depicts everything from daily life to intimate moments and even Yuuta's outrageous behavior. Additionally, the calm Riko-sensei takes a surprising turn! This new installment also reveals some incredibly surprising episodes leading up to the birth of their son, Eita!

[Translated from the [url=https://nijijyu.net/products/detail.php?product_id=1544]official store[/url]]
translation:
标志性的原创女主角理子老师即将回归！
自从她在上一个系列的结局中与悠太结合以来已经过去了几年。但原本应该是甜蜜的婚姻生活却出人意料，尤其是和臭名昭著的变态悠太在一起。这个故事描绘了从日常生活到亲密时刻，甚至裕太的令人发指的行为的一切。另外，冷静的梨子老师也发生了令人惊讶的转变！这部新剧还揭示了导致他们的儿子Eita出生的一些令人难以置信的令人惊讶的情节！
